replies.text:
Checks (step 2):
- Automated abuse reachable: "The endpoint is public and accepts any JSON body" — flooding covered by listed threat 5, order-id scraping/enumeration covered by listed threat 7; no sign-in, no email/SMS, no sign-up in the design.
- Staff/admin screen showing user-supplied content: design states nothing beyond "receives events from the payment provider and marks orders as paid" — no admin/support UI described. Not applicable.
- Money moving / state change with no record of who did it: present ("marks orders as paid") — already covered by listed threat 6.
- Cacheable personal/financial pages or documents: design describes only an inbound webhook, no response page or document. Not applicable.
- Attacker text into logs, exports, emails, headers: design mentions no logging, export, email or downstream text sink. Not applicable.
- Unconfirmed single-reviewer threat (acting on other customers' orders): real, but already stated in listed threat 2 ("send the id of someone else's order"). Not a gap.
